content: The references for Endrin, Epichlorohydrin, Fenitrothion, Fluoride, Halogenated acetonitriles, Hexachlorobenzene, and Inorganic tin should be moved to page 460. The reference for Glyphosate and AMPA should be updated from WHO (2003) to WHO (2005) and relocated to page 461, following the Formaldehyde reference. On page 459, the reference WHO (2003) MCPA in drinking-water should be deleted. Additionally, the references for Methoxychlor, Methyl parathion, Monochloramine, Monochloroacetic acid, Monochlorobenzene, and Parathion should be updated from WHO (2003) to WHO (2004) and moved to page 460. On page 460, the references for Sulfate and Vinyl chloride should also be updated from WHO (2003) to WHO (2004) and reorganized accordingly. All WHO (2004) references should be inserted below the WHO (2003) Zinc in drinking-water reference in alphabetical order. A new reference for WHO (2005) Bromate in drinking-water should be added below the WHO (2005) 1,4-Dioxane in drinking-water reference. The reference WHO (2005) Chlorite and chlorate in drinking-water should be deleted. On page 461, the reference WHO (2005) Nickel in drinking-water should be deleted, and a new reference for WHO (2007) Nickel in drinking-water should be added below the WHO (2005) Trihalomethanes in drinking-water reference. The reference for Petroleum products should be updated from WHO (2005) to WHO (2008) and moved below the WHO (2008) Novaluron in drinking-water reference. A new reference for WHO (2008) Pyriproxyfen in drinking-water should be added below the WHO (2008) Pirimiphos-methyl in drinking-water reference. On page 462, the reference WHO (2010) Pyriproxyfen in drinking-water should be deleted. On page 463, the references WHO (2011) Lead in drinking-water and WHO (2011) Nitrate and nitrite in drinking-water should be deleted. The reference for Uranium in drinking-water should be updated from WHO (2011) to WHO (2012). A new reference for WHO (2016) Barium in drinking-water should be inserted above Other references cited, along with references for WHO (2016) Bentazone in drinking-water, WHO (2016) Chlorine dioxide, chlorate, and chlorite in drinking-water, WHO (2016) Dichlorvos in drinking-water, WHO (2016) Dicofol in drinking-water, WHO (2016) Diquat in drinking-water, WHO (2016) Lead in drinking-water, WHO (2016) MCPA in drinking-water, WHO (2016) Nitrate and nitrite in drinking-water, and WHO (2016) Perchlorate in drinking-water. On page 464, the references FAO/WHO (1994) Pesticide residues in food—1993 evaluations and FAO/WHO (2002) Evaluation of certain food additives should be deleted. The reference FAO/WHO (2003) Nitrate (and potential endogenous formation of N-nitroso compounds) should also be deleted. A new reference for FAO/WHO (2011) Safety evaluation of certain contaminants in food should be added below the FAO/WHO (2011) Evaluation of certain contaminants in food reference. On page 465, the URL under Fluoride in drinking-water should be updated to http://www.int/water_sanitation_health/publications/fluoride-in-drinking-water/en/. A new reference for Health Canada (2013) Guidelines for Canadian Drinking Water Quality: Guideline Technical Document – Nitrate and nitrite should be added below the Fawell J et al. (2006) reference. On page 466, the reference Schmoll O et al. should be deleted, and a new reference for USEPA (2005) Toxicological review of barium and compounds should be inserted after ISO (1982). On page 467, a new reference for USNTP (1987) Toxicology and carcinogenesis studies of bromodichloromethane should be added at the top of the page. Additional references for WHO (2008) Acidified sodium chlorite, WHO (2012) Pesticide residues in food – 2011 evaluations, WHO (2013) Pesticide residues in food – 2012 evaluations, and WHO (2014) Pesticide residues in food – 2013 evaluations should be inserted below the WHO (2007) reference. In Annex 3, on page 469, the text for Bentazone should be updated to state: Occurs in drinking-water or drinking-water sources at concentrations well below those of health concern. The entry for Chlorine dioxide should be replaced with: Reduced primarily to chlorite, chlorate, and chloride in drinking-water, and to chlorite and chloride upon ingestion; the provisional guideline values for chlorite and chlorate are protective for potential toxicity from chlorine dioxide. On page 470, new entries for Dichlorvos and Dicofol should be added, with the former stating: Occurs in drinking-water or drinking-water sources at concentrations well below those of health concern, and the latter stating: Unlikely to occur in drinking-water or drinking-water sources. The entry for Diquat should be replaced with: Occurs in drinking-water or drinking-water sources at concentrations well below those of health concern. The superscript b on Glyphosate and AMPA should be changed to c. On page 471, the text for Manganese should be updated to: Not of health concern at levels normally causing acceptability problems in drinking-water. However, there are circumstances where manganese can remain in solution at higher concentrations in some acidic or anaerobic waters, particularly groundwater. A new entry for MCPA should be added, stating: Occurs in drinking-water or drinking-water sources at concentrations well below those of health concern. The superscript c on pH/Not of health concern at levels found in drinking-water should be changed to e. On page 472, a new footnote b should be added, stating: Although dicofol does not fulfill one of the three criteria for evaluation in the Guidelines, a background document has been prepared and a health-based value has been established, in response to a request from Member States for guidance. Footnote b should be changed to c, and a new footnote d should be added, stating: (2-Methyl-4-chlorophenoxy)acetic acid. In Annex 7, on page 509, the title should be updated to: Annex 7: Contributors to the development of the Guidelines for drinking-water quality: fourth edition incorporating the first addendum. The first sentence should be replaced with: This annex lists the names of those who have contributed to the development of the fourth edition of the Guidelines for drinking-water quality and to the first addendum to the fourth edition, through participation at relevant meetings, authorship or peer review of text in the Guidelines themselves or its supporting documents, or through provision of intellectual advice. The list of contributors should be replaced with the updated names provided.
